Shortly after, she is handed a beige paper bag with 'NAP TEA' printed on it; she hangs the bag handles over her wrist while still talking. After finishing the call, she realizes the absurdity of the objects she is holding and looks at the camera with a surprised and humorous expression as social media graphics appear.
